items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Alton Redd-- Ni Redd's father played bass drum; you know, we made him play the bass drum because he's kind of a heavy set man

ctx.x: Do you have a drum strapped on?

Uh huh. Yeah. We had about 5 snare drums and one bass drum, and Alton Redd-- Ni Redd's father played bass drum; you know, we made him play the bass drum because he's kind of a heavy set man, and we figured that he could take the whipping.
Marshall told me that in 1939, after having marched every year, they got flatbed trucks and Basie's band was in town and Lunceford's Luntzwood's band was in town and so they had 3 flatbed trucks ...
